fit_reason: Whole 1957 Ford Fairlane sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dull, chalky oxidized cream paint across the hood and front fenders
Heavy dust and speckled spotting on the hood and windshield
Dirt and grime along the lower door panels and rocker area on the passenger side
Whitewall tires dirty and discolored, with dull painted wheels missing hubcaps in photos
Dusty, grimy engine bay with flaking valve cover paint and dirt buildup
Interior floor pan bare and dirty with debris around the seat base
Door sill and jamb area on the passenger side stained and grimy
Front bumper chrome dull with spotting
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1957 Fairlane. The cream paint on the hood and fenders looks dull and chalky in the photos, and the door jambs and floor area could use a good cleaning. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a machine buff to bring back the gloss, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
